name: Walker Miles
style: Comfort-first casual shopper. Hands-free, cushioned, arch-supported — whoever ships that wins his foot, regardless of logo.
shopping_habits: Cross-shops Skechers, Hoka, Brooks, New Balance, Crocs, and the DSW / Famous Footwear sales aisle. Opens loyalty emails but doesn't let a points balance make the decision; the shoe that fits wins.
tech_comfort: Uses his phone for browsing, prefers simple navigation and larger text. Trusts a brand more when the email matches what he saw scrolling.
